title: Sync script, validation, docs, and PR
summary: Add sync script, validate plugin, write DECISIONS.md, update CHECKLIST, open PR to develop.
description:
Add a sync script to regenerate plugin files from _shared/ templates, validate the plugin, document everything, and open the PR to develop.

## Current state
- plugins/ structure and Claude Code plugin bundle exist (P001, P002).
- No sync script; derived files are hand-written initially.

## Work items
- scripts/sync-plugins.sh (or .cjs) — regenerate each plugin's skills/planner/SKILL.md and scripts/notify-session-start.sh from _shared/ templates by substituting {{HARNESS}}/{{LOAD_COMMAND}}.
- Run `claude plugin validate ./plugins/claude-code` (if CLI available) or manual structure check against the plugin spec.
- docs/DECISIONS.md (or plugins/DECISIONS.md) — detailed record of D1–D10 decisions with rationale.
- Update CHECKLIST.md with this improvement.
- Open PR feat/claude-code-plugin → develop (per AGENTS.md §12: feature branch from develop, PR to develop).

## Behaviors to preserve
- Single source of truth: edits go to _shared/, then sync regenerates derived files.
- develop is the integration branch; main is release-only.

## Code references
- scripts/copy-web-ui.sh — existing sync script pattern to follow for scripts/sync-plugins.sh.

tasks.title: Create sync-plugins script
tasks.description:
Create scripts/sync-plugins.sh (or .cjs) that regenerates each plugin's skills/planner/SKILL.md and scripts/notify-session-start.sh from _shared/ templates by substituting {{HARNESS}} and {{LOAD_COMMAND}}. Pattern follows scripts/copy-web-ui.sh. Enforces single source of truth (D2): edits go to _shared/, derived files are regenerated.

File: scripts/sync-plugins.sh. Reference: scripts/copy-web-ui.sh.

---
**Completion summary:**
Created scripts/sync-plugins.cjs (CommonJS, since root is ESM). Substitutes {{HARNESS}}/{{LOAD_COMMAND}} from plugins/_shared/ into each plugin's derived files. --check mode for CI drift guard. Verified claude-code files in sync. Added pnpm scripts plugins:sync and plugins:check. HARNESSES table makes adding a new harness a one-entry change.

tasks.title: Validate Claude Code plugin
tasks.description:
Validate the plugin structure (run `claude plugin validate ./plugins/claude-code` if the CLI is available, otherwise manual check against the Claude Code plugin spec: manifest present, .mcp.json valid, skills/ and hooks/ well-formed, marketplace.json valid). Fix any issues found.

Reference: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins for the spec.

---

Plugin validation: `claude plugin validate ./plugins/claude-code` → ✔ Validation passed (CLI v2.1.209). All 6 files present, all JSON valid, notify script executable (-rwxr-xr-x). pnpm check clean. sync-plugins --check: all in sync.
